```{r}
# ============================================================
# 01_data_audit
# Airline Service Performance Visual Analytics
# ============================================================


# 1. LOAD PACKAGES --------------------------------------------------------

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)


# 2. FILE PATH ------------------------------------------------------------

file_path <- "D:/data-portfolio/08_airline_service_performance_visual_analytics/data/raw/Dataset Assignment 2.xlsx"


# 3. CHECK SHEET NAMES ----------------------------------------------------

sheet_names <- excel_sheets(file_path)

cat("\n=== SHEET NAMES ===\n")
print(sheet_names)


# 4. READ THE MAIN SHEET --------------------------------------------------

main_data <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "2020-23 OTP"
)

cat("\n=== ORIGINAL COLUMN NAMES ===\n")
print(names(main_data))


# 5. CREATE SIMPLE COLUMN NAMES -------------------------------------------

clean_column_names <- c(
  "Route",
  "Departing_Port",
  "Arriving_Port",
  "Airline",
  "Month",
  "Sectors_Scheduled",
  "Sectors_Flown",
  "Cancellations",
  "Departures_On_Time",
  "Arrivals_On_Time",
  "Departures_Delayed",
  "Arrivals_Delayed",
  "OnTime_Departures_Percent",
  "OnTime_Arrivals_Percent",
  "Cancellations_Percent"
)

names(main_data) <- clean_column_names

cat("\n=== CLEAN COLUMN NAMES ===\n")
print(names(main_data))


# 6. CHECK EACH SHEET -----------------------------------------------------

sheet_summary <- data.frame(
  Sheet = character(),
  Rows = numeric(),
  Columns = numeric()
)

for (sheet in sheet_names) {
  
  data <- read_excel(
    file_path,
    sheet = sheet
  )
  
  new_row <- data.frame(
    Sheet = sheet,
    Rows = nrow(data),
    Columns = ncol(data)
  )
  
  sheet_summary <- bind_rows(
    sheet_summary,
    new_row
  )
}

cat("\n=== SHEET SUMMARY ===\n")
print(sheet_summary)


# 7. CHECK 2020 DUPLICATION -----------------------------------------------

data_2020_main <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "2020-23 OTP"
)

data_2020_old <- read_excel(
  file_path,
  sheet = "2020"
)

names(data_2020_main) <- clean_column_names
names(data_2020_old) <- clean_column_names

data_2020_main <- data_2020_main %>%
  filter(
    format(as.Date(Month), "%Y") == "2020"
  )

duplicate_2020 <- inner_join(
  data_2020_main,
  data_2020_old,
  by = c(
    "Route",
    "Departing_Port",
    "Arriving_Port",
    "Airline",
    "Month"
  )
)

cat("\n=== 2020 DUPLICATE CHECK ===\n")

cat(
  "2020 rows in 2020-23 OTP:",
  nrow(data_2020_main),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Rows in standalone 2020 sheet:",
  nrow(data_2020_old),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Matching 2020 keys:",
  nrow(duplicate_2020),
  "\n"
)


# 8. CHOOSE SHEETS FOR THE MASTER DATA ------------------------------------

sheets_to_use <- sheet_names[
  sheet_names != "2020"
]

cat("\n=== SHEETS USED ===\n")
print(sheets_to_use)


# 9. READ AND COMBINE THE SHEETS ------------------------------------------

data_list <- list()

for (sheet in sheets_to_use) {
  
  data <- read_excel(
    file_path,
    sheet = sheet,
    range = cell_cols("A:O")
  )
  
  names(data) <- clean_column_names
  
  data$Source_Sheet <- sheet
  
  data_list[[sheet]] <- data
}

master_raw <- bind_rows(data_list)


# 10. KEEP REAL DATA ROWS -------------------------------------------------

master_data <- master_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Route),
    Route != "",
    !is.na(Month)
  )


# 11. CHECK DATASET SIZE --------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== DATASET OVERVIEW ===\n")

cat(
  "Number of rows:",
  nrow(master_data),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of columns:",
  ncol(master_data),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Date range:",
  as.character(min(master_data$Month)),
  "to",
  as.character(max(master_data$Month)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of months:",
  n_distinct(master_data$Month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of airline labels:",
  n_distinct(master_data$Airline),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of route labels:",
  n_distinct(master_data$Route),
  "\n"
)


# 12. CHECK AIRPORT NAMES -------------------------------------------------

airport_names <- c(
  master_data$Departing_Port,
  master_data$Arriving_Port
)

airport_names <- unique(airport_names)

airport_names <- airport_names[
  !is.na(airport_names) &
    airport_names != "All Ports"
]

cat("\n=== AIRPORT CHECK ===\n")

cat(
  "Number of physical airport names:",
  length(airport_names),
  "\n"
)

print(
  sort(airport_names)
)


# 13. CHECK AIRLINE NAMES -------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== AIRLINE LABELS ===\n")

print(
  sort(
    unique(master_data$Airline)
  )
)


# 14. CREATE FOUR ANALYTICAL LEVELS ---------------------------------------

network_month <- master_data %>%
  filter(
    Route == "All Ports-All Ports",
    Airline == "All Airlines"
  )


airline_month <- master_data %>%
  filter(
    Route == "All Ports-All Ports",
    Airline != "All Airlines"
  )


route_month <- master_data %>%
  filter(
    Route != "All Ports-All Ports",
    Airline == "All Airlines"
  )


airline_route_month <- master_data %>%
  filter(
    Route != "All Ports-All Ports",
    Airline != "All Airlines"
  )


cat("\n=== ANALYTICAL DATA LEVELS ===\n")

cat(
  "Network-month rows:",
  nrow(network_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Airline-month rows:",
  nrow(airline_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Route-month rows:",
  nrow(route_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Airline-route-month rows:",
  nrow(airline_route_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Total rows across four levels:",
  nrow(network_month) +
    nrow(airline_month) +
    nrow(route_month) +
    nrow(airline_route_month),
  "\n"
)


# 15. CHECK MISSING OTP VALUES --------------------------------------------

departure_otp <- as.character(
  master_data$OnTime_Departures_Percent
)

arrival_otp <- as.character(
  master_data$OnTime_Arrivals_Percent
)

missing_departure_otp <- sum(
  is.na(departure_otp) |
    tolower(trimws(departure_otp)) == "na"
)

missing_arrival_otp <- sum(
  is.na(arrival_otp) |
    tolower(trimws(arrival_otp)) == "na"
)

cat("\n=== MISSING OTP CHECK ===\n")

cat(
  "Missing Departure OTP values:",
  missing_departure_otp,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Missing Arrival OTP values:",
  missing_arrival_otp,
  "\n"
)


# 16. CHECK ZERO SECTORS FLOWN --------------------------------------------

zero_flown <- master_data %>%
  filter(
    Sectors_Flown == 0
  )

cat("\n=== ZERO SECTORS FLOWN ===\n")

cat(
  "Rows with zero sectors flown:",
  nrow(zero_flown),
  "\n"
)

print(
  zero_flown %>%
    select(
      Route,
      Departing_Port,
      Arriving_Port,
      Airline,
      Month,
      Sectors_Scheduled,
      Sectors_Flown,
      Cancellations,
      OnTime_Departures_Percent,
      OnTime_Arrivals_Percent
    ) %>%
    head(10)
)


# 17. CHECK DUPLICATED KEYS -----------------------------------------------

duplicate_keys <- master_data %>%
  count(
    Route,
    Departing_Port,
    Arriving_Port,
    Airline,
    Month
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n > 1
  )

cat("\n=== DUPLICATE KEY CHECK ===\n")

cat(
  "Number of duplicated keys:",
  nrow(duplicate_keys),
  "\n"
)

print(
  head(
    duplicate_keys,
    10
  )
)


# 18. AUDIT FINISHED ------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== AUDIT FINISHED ===\n")
```
